articles.title: No criminal charges to be laid in alleged Oshawa courthouse assault of lawyer, investigation finds
articles.summary: York Regional Police will not be proceeding with criminal charges against Durham Regional Police Service officers following an investigation into the arrest and alleged assault of a lawyer at the Oshawa courthouse earlier this year.

articles.title: Toronto police say online escort drugged, robbed client who was seeking sexual encounter
articles.summary: A person seeking a sexual encounter with an online escort was instead drugged and robbed, Toronto police investigators say. It happened on Friday, July 24, at around 2:30 a.m. when a prospective client contacted a woman through an online advertisement. The woman showed up at the person’s residence in the John Street and King Street […]

articles.title: Peel officer disciplined after leaving gun in mall change room
articles.summary: A Peel Regional Police (PRP) constable who accidentally left her police‑issued firearm and use‑of‑force equipment unattended in a mall change room will forfeit 15 days, or 120 hours, after a disciplinary settlement found her actions undermined public trust. The decision, finalized in a June 19, 2026 settlement agreement and released through the police tribunal system, […]

articles.title: York police clear Durham officers in controversial Oshawa courthouse arrest
articles.summary: Durham Regional Police say an independent investigation has found no reasonable grounds to lay criminal charges against officers involved in the controversial arrest of defence lawyer Sudine Riley at the Oshawa courthouse earlier this year. The update comes after York Regional Police (YRP) completed a months‑long investigation into the Jan. 23 incident at the Superior […]

articles.title: Masked man who was allegedly seen riding bike with gun arrested: Toronto police
articles.summary: Toronto police investigators have arrested a man who was allegedly spotted carrying a gun while donning a ski mask in North York last Friday. Officers were called about a suspicious incident in the Yonge Street and Empress Avenue area on Friday, July 24, at around 1:08 p.m. Investigators say a man wearing a balaclava was […]

articles.title: Hamilton man fighting for refund after disastrous Sunwing vacation to Dominican Republic
articles.summary: A Hamilton man says a tropical getaway in the Dominican Republic for a special occasion turned into a nightmarish ordeal he could not wait to escape from. Mali Muma booked a $3,500, week-long trip to Riu Republica in Punta Cana with Sunwing Vacations for his girlfriend’s birthday in May. However, he says the celebration was […]

articles.title: Oakville councillor remembered as 'trusted friend, colleague' after sudden death
articles.summary: After 23 years of service to the Town of Oakville, Coun. Marc Reyer Grant passed away on Monday from a "sudden illness," said friend and former councillor Jeff Knoll.

articles.title: Brampton teen wanted in attempted murder arrested after Canada‑wide warrant
articles.summary: A 19‑year‑old Brampton man wanted on a Canada‑wide warrant in connection with a violent shooting earlier this year has been arrested, Peel Regional Police say. Authorities confirmed Wednesday that Kaleb Kimotho — who had been the subject of a national search — is now in custody. Investigators thanked policing partners across the GTA for assisting […]

articles.title: Peel Region shelter crisis deepens as intimate partner violence incidents rise
articles.summary: As intimate partner violence incidents rise in Peel Region, local leaders say provincially funded emergency shelters are overburdened and hamstrung by outdated funding rules. Mississauga’s mayor and the Peel Regional Council have called for more support.

articles.title: Allan Gardens could get a major greenhouse expansion if the city puts in $10M: councillor
articles.summary: A Toronto councillor and volunteer-based community organization are calling on the city to put $9 million more toward expanding the Allan Gardens greenhouse complex.

articles.title: Ontario rethinking support for high-speed rail after feds reject Billy Bishop expansion: source
articles.summary: The federal government's rejection of a plan to allow commercial jets at Toronto's Billy Bishop Airport is threatening a wedge between the Ford government and Ottawa — and potentially strengthening opposition to a major high-speed rail project.

articles.title: Child in critical condition after being pulled from Mississauga pool
articles.summary: A child has been pulled from a pool at a Mississauga home and rushed to hospital in life-threatening condition, Peel police say.

articles.title: Patrick Brown seeking 3rd term as Brampton mayor
articles.summary: Brown, who was first elected in 2018, says he is running to see through "transformational" transit and infrastructure projects, and he will continue to focus on public safety.

articles.title: Police searching for left-handed shooter in 2022 Scarborough slaying
articles.summary: Over three years after Toronto man Ding Ping Wang was shot and killed inside a car in a Scarborough industrial plaza parking lot, investigators are releasing new information in the hopes that someone can help them track down his killer.

articles.title: Etobicoke waste transfer station has 2nd major fire in under a year
articles.summary: An industrial fire broke out shortly before 4 a.m. Tuesday near Disco Road and Highway 427, emergency responders say. The fire is now under control, according to Toronto Fire, but crews are expected to be on the scene all day.
